newsitem.title: FRANCE: Minister sees more concentration in French retail.
newsitem.headline: Minister sees more concentration in French retail.

text.p: Jean Pierre Raffarin, the French minister in charge of small businesses, predicted further concentration among large French retailers in a newspaper interview on Thursday after Carrefour's move to acquire 33.34 percent of hypermarkets company Cora.

"Other developments of this type are likely since the French hypermarket sector has reached full capacity and companies want to become stronger to develop on an international scale," Raffarin told Le Figaro.

Raffarin, who spearheaded a law to limit the size of hypermarkets in France to protect small shop owners, said the French retail sector was now well balanced between large groups able to compete at an international level and small local businesses shielded from overwhelming competition.
